protocol.reasoning_expansion: Expand only if NLL and generation evidence justify a quality-preservation claim.
protocol.downstream_claim: First-wave samples are underpowered. Truncated answers do not establish model accuracy.
protocol.training_overlap: Dataset selection is independent of tuning. Training overlap is not audited.
protocol.category_limit: Category labels describe source domains, not certified document genres.

redistribution: Raw language passages stay local. IDs, source revisions, and text hashes enable reconstruction.
